background.value: Pure white background, free of shadows or any visible elements

validity.value: Photo must be recent, not exceeding six months old

clothing_restriction.value: No specific restriction on ordinary/everyday clothing is stated

expression_restriction.value: Neutral facial expression required; no exaggerated smile or frown

glasses_policy.value: Sunglasses / tinted glasses are not permitted

face_visibility.value: Photo taken from a frontal angle showing the full facial features together with the shoulders; face must be clearly visible

accessories.value: Accessories that obscure facial features are not permitted; no digital retouching, filters or effects allowed

official_source_url.value: https://www.cspd.gov.jo/ (Civil Status and Passports Department / CSPD, دائرة الأحوال المدنية والجوازات — Ministry of Interior, Jordan). CSPD's E-Services page names a specific resource, 'ICAO Photo Specifications for the Personal Photo', at the ListDetails URL, confirming CSPD itself publishes these specs, though the resource renders as a non-extractable graphic to this research tool.

clothing.ja: 普段着の着用について特別な制限規定はない。

cross_verification.note: cspd.gov.jo's E-Services homepage (Arabic) explicitly links to a resource titled 'ICAO Photo Specifications for the Personal Photo' at /AR/ListDetails/.../42/1006, confirming CSPD does publish these specs, but the page delivers them as a graphic/image that this tool's HTML-to-text pipeline could not extract (tried direct fetch and an r.jina.ai proxy fetch; both returned only surrounding page chrome, not the graphic content). Field values above are therefore sourced from convergent, contemporaneous Jordanian news coverage that explicitly attributes the same figures to an official CSPD announcement: Al Rai (alrai.com, published by the Jordan Press Foundation, in which the Jordanian government holds an ownership stake) dated the announcement on/around 22 January 2026 and reported size 35x45mm, white background free of shadows/visible elements, 6-month validity, frontal framing with shoulders, neutral expression, and a ban on sunglasses/face-obscuring accessories. Al Dustour (addustour.com) independently reported matching figures and additionally specified that both ears and the face must be clearly visible, and that there is no specific restriction on ordinary clothing. Roya News (royanews.com) independently reported matching size/background/expression/accessory figures and explicitly stated the source is an official CSPD announcement. All three name CSPD (دائرة الأحوال المدنية والجوازات) as the source. Commercial passport-photo vendor sites (mybiometricphotos.com, visafoto.com, ipassportphoto.com, idphotodiy.com, etc.) were excluded per the truthfulness gate even where their claims coincided; a few of their claims that do NOT appear in any CSPD-attributed news coverage found in this pass (exact head-height 33mm, digital pixel dimensions 826x1062, 600 DPI scan resolution, an unconditional prescription-glasses ban, and a hat/religious-exception clause) were deliberately NOT carried into verified and are left in unverified/uncited instead. jordan.gov.jo and moi.gov.jo (the general e-government portal, checked previously for jo-visa.json) do not host this detail — cspd.gov.jo is confirmed as the correct primary authority for Jordan passport photos. Size and background both match the DB exactly; no db_conflicts found.
